changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM study_user_role WHERE user_name = 'root' AND role_name = 'coordinator' AND status_id = 1;

changeSet.comment:
2026-06-22 user-feedback round 8 follow-up. The create-study endpoint used to bind every creator (including sysadmins) as Role.COORDINATOR. The 2026-06-22 fix flipped sysadmin creators to Role.ADMIN going forward, but study_user_role rows persisted from earlier creates (e.g. a GA Studie a sysadmin created during round-2 testing) still showed the operator as "CRC" in the study picker — mismatching the "Administrator" pill they see on the seeded Default Study.
Flip any AVAILABLE coordinator-binding root holds on a user-created study to admin so the picker presents a consistent role label. Defence in depth: only the root user is touched; other CRC bindings (physician / datamanager / monitor demo users) keep their roles. The preCondition gates on at least one row existing so the changeset is a no-op on fresh databases.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE study_user_role SET role_name = 'admin', date_updated = NOW(), update_id = (SELECT user_id FROM user_account WHERE user_name = 'root') WHERE user_name = 'root' AND role_name = 'coordinator' AND status_id = 1;
